name: p2-ip-only-zipcpu-uart-wishbone
description: One ZipCPU wbuart target model driven as a classic Wishbone register target behind the real beat_to_wishbone kernel, no CPU and no DMA. Each case line states the cyc/stb/ack/we/adr/dat_w/dat_r/sel handshake the slave's own pins carried. The core is word addressed, so the byte offset a case reports is the sampled wb_adr times four. The UART pin inputs are pinned by the declaration (rx idle high, cts_n asserted) and are not driven.

transactions.note: SETUP reset value is the elaboration constant INITIAL_SETUP=25 (0x19); the slave returns {1'b0, uart_setup}
SETUP = 10 clocks per bit (byte 0 through wb_sel[0])
FIFO_STATUS is read-only; the word is recorded, not asserted
TXREG: pushes 0x41 (the byte "A") into the transmit FIFO; this is a real device action, and the next FIFO_STATUS read observes its effect
the transmitter starts shifting the byte out at 10 clocks per bit
FIFO_STATUS after the push: a real observed word
